report: 图像整体呈现出较高的微小噪声水平和强烈的 JPEG 压缩结构，这与真实拍摄的照片一致。然而，图像整体的蓝色像素块状分布可能是由于 JPEG 压缩造成的，而不是伪造的迹象。此外，图像中的眼睛区域虽然有不自然的皮肤纹理，但不足以作为伪造的明确证据。综合考虑这些因素，现有工具无法进一步降低不确定性。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 3.3681: the camera end of the G2 calibration band. Residual consistent with a camera sensor; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 3.3681 (high). The G2 calibration set associates this band with camera capture: sensor noise that survives re-encoding. High residual does NOT indicate forgery — that is the original reading this expert was calibrated against — and sharpening inflates the metric with no sensor involved.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.28); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: High residual micro-noise level — spatially rich sensor noise of the kind the calibration set associates with camera capture.

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 1.5757, DCT anomaly: 4.3411)
evidence.reasoning: Strong JPEG compression structure found (blockiness=1.5757, DCT anomaly=4.3411). Gradient energy at 8×8 block boundaries and DCT histogram structure indicate the image originates from a JPEG photograph that was saved or re-saved — the direction the G2 calibration set associates with real capture. This is NOT a forgery marker: high values do not indicate tampering, and uniform re-compression (quality ≤ 70) removes most of this signal's discriminative power.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.39); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: High JPEG structural level — blockiness and DCT structure of the kind the calibration set associates with a camera JPEG that was saved or re-saved (real capture), not with forgery.
